summary: Durably cancel observed OMP questions when their admitted native session or driver lifetime ends, including abrupt loss without reconnect; all observation flags remain off by default and answering remains unavailable.

replay.detail: Startup retires unresolved locally ingested OMP observations predating generation leases because their admitted wrapper generation cannot be recovered. This bounded background recovery writes cancelled resolutions without answers or receipts; foreign observations are preserved and the API does not wait for the sweep.

schema.detail: Store open creates local_harness_question_generations if absent, without a numeric schema version change. The owner-local, non-replicated table records exact admitted native question generation witnesses before publishing an observation and removes them after durable resolution. No replicated claim, checkpoint or client schema changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint, replication rules or coordinated member upgrade requirement changes.

compatibility.detail: Existing question.closed/cancelled semantics are retained with empty answers and no person receipt. No client-v0 or native settlement wire changes. Exact managed wrapper admission remains required; no answer sink is installed.

downtime.detail: No additional planned interruption. Lifecycle reconciliation is bounded background work; startup-to-health timing for larger stores has not been measured.

manual.detail: No new operator steps. Observation still requires independent explicit ST_OMP_WEB_ANSWERS=1 opt-ins; every default remains off. Cleanup of already observed questions continues with the flag off.

recovery.detail: Generation leases and immutable cancelled resolutions survive restart. Unavailable evidence preserves pending questions; definitive process, provider or native session loss retires them. Reinstalling an older binary does not undo the added table or cancelled resolutions; older observation code does not run this lifecycle cleanup, so roll forward to retain that behavior.
